item.title: Vance says war in "new phase" of economic pressure as Iran dismisses Trump threat
item.description: Iran has shrugged off President Trump's threat to hit the Islamic Republic with an "economic D-Day" as a "doubling down on failed policies."

item.title: Woman accused of plotting "major attack" on New York State Capitol building
item.description: A New York woman is accused of plotting "a major attack" on the state Capitol building in Albany, authorities said Thursday.

item.title: Charter plane carrying 8 crashes in western Alaska, federal officials say
item.description: A charter plane carrying eight people crashed Thursday near a remote radar site in western Alaska, federal authorities said.

item.title: Storms soak Northeast as possible tornadoes reported in New York, Delaware
item.description: Heavy rain and winds were pounding the Northeast U.S. as storms tore through a beach on Long Island and knocked out power in Delaware's capital city.

item.title: Liberia receives first group of "third country" deportees from U.S., officials say
item.description: The West African nation of Liberia received the first group of "third country" deportees from the U.S. on Thursday, including migrants from Latin America, U.S. officials told CBS News.

item.title: Aisha Wahab wins special election to serve out remainder of Eric Swalwell's term
item.description: The partial term for California's 14th Congressional District ends January 2027, after which the candidate chosen in the November election will serve the next full term.

item.title: She was a California comeback story, serving juvenile probation in a UC Davis dorm for killing a teen, when arrested again
item.description: A Sacramento County judge ordered her into a UC Davis program for formerly incarcerated students. She was arrested seven months later, accused of dealing drugs from her dorm, where officers found ammunition.

item.title: ICE, Iran quietly worked together on deporting Iranians to Iran, emails show
item.description: U.S. immigration officials worked with Iran to deport more than 100 Iranians to Iran in 2025, newly released emails show, revealing a working relationship between them despite tensions mounting at the time.

item.title: Philadelphia police ID man in "Chucky-style" mask as Zymire Hughes
item.description: Police have identified the suspect wanted for terrorizing people near Philadelphia City Hall last week while wearing a "Chucky-style" mask.

item.title: Pilot killed as plane collides with police helicopter at airport, officials say
item.description: One person was killed and two Pennsylvania State Police troopers were injured when a small plane collided with a state police helicopter on the ground in central Pennsylvania, authorities said.

item.title: Army to nix drone battalion set up to absorb lessons from Ukraine war
item.description: The decision to phase out the Army drone battalion comes amid tension between senior officers who envisioned the unit and the acting chief of staff of the Army.

item.title: Drug mix-up at Nashville hospital causes complications in 4 patients
item.description: Four patients at Ascension Saint Thomas Midtown received incorrect medications last week, CBS affiliate WTVF reported.

item.title: Breaking down postpartum psychosis amid the Lindsay Clancy trial
item.description: Hundreds of Lindsay Clancy supporters rallied outside the courthouse on Thursday, where she's on trial for murder in the killings of her three children. Shanelle Kaul reports on postpartum psychosis, the rare, but treatable illness Clancy's defense team argues made her not responsible for the crime.

item.title: USS Abraham Lincoln leaving Middle East after 9-month deployment
item.description: The aircraft carrier and its 5,000 crew members will return to San Diego after an approximately nine-month deployment.

item.title: Why an Instagram bench-rater gave out his first 10/10 in 7 years
item.description: A man who, instead of rating movies or restaurants, rates benches on Instagram, just gave out his first 10/10, a milestone seven years and 300 reviews in the making. Tony Dokoupil has the story.

item.title: Hayden Panettiere's death under scrutiny with DEA investigation
item.description: The U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration has joined the investigation into the sudden death of actress Hayden Panettiere, who would have turned 37 on Friday. Mark Strassmann reports.

item.title: U.S. Army phases out new drone battalion, despite being far behind in drone race
item.description: The U.S. Army decided to phase out a new drone battalion set up earlier this year to help the U.S. catch up in its use of the crucial technology. The decision to shut it down came amid tension between top Army officials, including two who were fired or forced into early retirement. Charlie D'Agata reports.

item.title: Medical nightmare in Tennessee hospital after drug mix-up
item.description: A dangerous drug mix-up at a Tennessee hospital left several patients badly injured this week. Nicole Valdes reports.

item.title: Video captures plane hitting Pennsylvania State Police helicopter in midair
item.description: Warning: disturbing video. A deadly collision was caught on camera in Pennsylvania on Wednesday. A small plane slammed into a state police helicopter at an airport outside the state capital of Harrisburg. Michael George reports.

item.title: Inside Disney and ABC's First Amendment rights as they sue FCC over early license renewal
item.description: Disney and ABC is suing the government over claims that it restricted its First Amendment rights by requesting early license renewals in response to content critical of the Trump administration. CBS News' legal contributor Jessica Levinson gives her analysis.

item.title: Fierce rain swamps Ohio, Kansas, Nebraska, storms hit Mid-Atlantic
item.description: A line of potentially dangerous storms slammed the Mid-Atlantic on Thursday after downpours earlier in Ohio triggered dozens of flash floods. Lonnie Quinn tracks it all.

item.title: Woman arrested for plot to blow up New York State Capitol
item.description: The FBI announced the arrest of a 35-year-old woman they said had converted to Islam, expressed support for terrorism online, and allegedly developed a plan of her own to blow up the New York State Capitol. Meg Oliver reports.

item.title: Neutrogena shares statement on Hayden Panettiere after backlash
item.description: After Hayden Panettiere's death, fans resurfaced her claim that Neutrogena had fired her in 2015 over her comments about postpartum depression.

item.title: Obama's former "body man" Reggie Love on working for the ex-president
item.description: What if you had an assistant, babysitter, lunch companion, scheduler, and friend, all in one person? Well, lawmakers have that, and they're called "body people." Reggie Love, who served as former President Barack Obama's "body man" from 2007 to 2011, joins "The Takeout" to discuss his experience.

item.title: FBI seizes Swalwell's devices, executes warrants in sexual misconduct probe
item.description: FBI agents executed search warrants targeting former Democratic Rep. Eric Swalwell and seized his electronic devices, two sources told CBS News.

item.title: 8/20: CBS Evening News
item.description: Woman arrested in alleged plot to blow up New York State Capitol; fierce rain swamps Ohio, Kansas and Nebraska as storms hit Mid-Atlantic.

item.title: Democratic socialist talks agenda as she looks to unseat embattled Rep. Jimmy Gomez
item.description: The House Ethics Committee confirmed this week that it is investigating sexual misconduct allegations against Democratic Rep. Jimmy Gomez of California, who denies the claims. Angela Gonzales-Torres, a democratic socialist who is running against Gomez in California's Los Angeles-based 34th district, joins to discuss.

item.title: New details about Trump's plans for Kennedy Center and White House ballroom
item.description: The latest court filings in cases involving the Kennedy Center and the White House ballroom project detail the work being done at the two institutions.

item.title: Democrats narrow 2028 convention finalists to 3 cities
item.description: The Democratic National Committee is on the hunt for the best host city for the 2028 Democratic convention.

item.title: NASA's Swift telescope will plunge toward Earth after rescue mission called off
item.description: The mission to save NASA's sinking space telescope has been called off, dooming the telescope to a fiery reentry later this year.
